title: Rare-book theft ring and the burning of stolen books

tellings.quote: they were arrested for committing the largest rare book theft in America's history.

plain: Peter Levenda, an author who writes about the occult and secret history, says that in the early to mid 1970s a group he knew was arrested for what he calls the largest rare book theft in American history. The story, as he frames it, also involves stolen books being burned. He tells it as part of a strange circle he was drawn into in New York.
